## >>> RETEST ME — PPO_POLICY_V4_GOALDIRECTED.pt (2026-07-20) <<<
This is the answer to your gameplay feedback that `PPO_POLICY_V4_INTEGRATED`
(a) commits aerials off walls with **no boost** in risky spots, and (b) when it
aerials it **hovers under the ball and doesn't play toward the goal**.

Reward was reshaped (not just more training) to fix exactly those two things:
- **Goal-direction:** dense carry reward is now multiplied by goal-progress — an
  aerial touch that doesn't drive the ball toward the opponent net pays only
  0.15x. Hovering is no longer worth much; carrying it goal-ward is.
- **Boost discipline:** committing to an aerial carry with < 10% boost now takes
  a penalty instead of earning reward, so it should stop throwing itself at balls
  it can't finish from no-boost wall positions.
- **Re-touch to score:** cut the boost-spend penalty (boost_change 20->8) and
  raised the touch-chain reward, so boosting *up* to re-hit the ball toward net
  is rewarded, not punished.

Resumed from the 7-day headline and trained ~650M more steps with the new reward
(this file = the 634M-step checkpoint; run has since CONVERGED). Headless metrics
(these CANNOT see the behavior change — that's why I need your in-game read):
strength score **~0.37** vs Element across 8 evals (>= the 0.34 headline, well
above floor), spawn air-dribble capability **~0.80** (noisy proxy, up from 0.66).

**What to check when you play it:** Does it still go for aerials off walls with
no boost? When it air-dribbles, does it now try to move the ball toward the goal
(vs hovering)? Does it boost up to re-touch in a goal-ward direction? A/B it
against PPO_POLICY_V4_INTEGRATED (the old hover-y one) to feel the difference.
Training is still running; this is an in-progress checkpoint, not a final headline.
